result.title: Motor compound fault diagnosis using an attention-based cross-talk architecture
result.summary: As physical AI increasingly relies on sensing to understand physical systems, reliable condition monitoring of industrial machinery has become more important. Motors are ubiquitous in industrial systems, and increasing system complexity raises the likelihood of simultaneous faults. Accordingly, compound fault diagnosis that identifies multiple fault components and their severities is increasingly required. Because different fault components jointly affect the same vibration signal, their severity classification can be formulated as related tasks, making multi-task learning (MTL) suitable for exploiting shared information. However, conventional shared-trunk architectures force tasks to share a common representation, potentially causing negative transfer because fault components are characterized by different time-frequency regions. To address this issue, this study proposes a Residual Neural Dimension Reductor with Time-Frequency Channel Attention (RNDR-TFCA), an attention-enhanced cross-talk architecture for multi-output compound fault diagnosis. RNDR-TFCA preserves task-specific feature extractors while selectively exchanging information across tasks. Time-frequency attention emphasizes informative intra-task regions, while channel attention enhances useful inter-task information after nonlinear feature fusion. Experiments on a rotor-bearing system with inner-race fault, outer-race fault, misalignment, and unbalance showed that RNDR-TFCA achieved a macro F1 score of 0.898, outperforming single-task, multi-class, shared-trunk, and cross-talk baselines. Ablation experiments confirmed the benefit of jointly applying both attention mechanisms. RNDR-TFCA required 713 K parameters and 170.42 MMACs, only slightly higher than RNDR. Channel-expanded baselines still underperformed RNDR-TFCA, indicating that the gain was not simply attributable to increased model capacity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对电机复合故障诊断，提出 RNDR-TFCA：保留任务专属特征提取器，再用时间—频率注意力与通道注意力在任务间选择性交换信息，实现多输出诊断，在转子—轴承系统上宏 F1 达 0.898，优于单任务、共享主干与 cross-talk 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「任务专属分支＋选择性跨任务交换＋注意力筛选信息流」的做法，可能为多子任务 latent 推理中避免共享表征坍缩与负迁移提供线索，与视觉证据筛选、并行 latent 假设协调的机制可供核查。
